data.gender_notes: Mahsumah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'mahsoum', which means 'protected' or 'sanctified'. In Islamic tradition, Mahsumah represents the state of being protected from sin and its consequences. The name Mahsumah carries the meaning “Pure, Innocent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahsumah usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, innocent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes spiritual purity and innocence in Islam.
data.etymology: Mahsumah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Innocent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahsumah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
